name: job-application-automation
description: Fully automated job application system with AI matching

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend && npm run install:automation && npm run install:fetcher
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:fetcher" "npm run dev:automation"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:automation && npm run build:fetcher
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
